description: Remote serving: the request header a caller sends to forbid remote serving, and the response headers that say which side served. A server emits the response headers; an SDK reads each into request metadata and drops a value outside its declared values or pattern.

notes.served_by: local or remote. Present on a served response.
notes.upstream: The upstream's name, present only when served remotely.
notes.fallback_reason: The trigger that sent a request for the bare model name to its remote profile.
notes.fallback_error: An SIE error code. Present when the remote attempt failed and the response is the local refusal it was meant to replace.
notes.metadata_fields: The Python SDK keeps the keys above as request metadata field names; the TypeScript SDK camelCases them (servedBy, upstream, fallbackReason, fallbackError).
